name: PersonList
description: The people in a popover: who is viewing, who has read it. A `ul`, the column of list cells (2px between rows, 8px at its ends); put it straight in `PopoverContent`, under a `PopoverHeader` if it has one, with no `PopoverBody` around it: each row brings its own 8px inset.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

name: PersonListItem
description: One person: an `li` holding the row. The row is a `button` by default; pass `render={<a />}` (or a router link) for a row that goes to a page. Every prop, `className`, `ref` and `render` go to the row, not the `li`. Children: an `xs` `Avatar`, `PersonListItemName`, then up to two `PersonListItemStatus`; or, for a two-line row, an `sm` `Avatar` and a `PersonListItemContent` holding the name and a `PersonListItemDescription`.

props.name: interactive
props.description: `false` renders a row that opens nothing: a `div` with no hover, press or focus, for someone who can't be opened (a deleted person or agent, a system row).

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

name: PersonListItemContent
description: The text column of a two-line row: `PersonListItemName`, then `PersonListItemDescription` under it. The name is bold here.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

name: PersonListItemDescription
description: What the person is doing, in a sentence (an agent's current step), under the name in `PersonListItemContent`: `text-footnote`, `foreground-muted`, up to 2 lines, then cut with an ellipsis. The row is announced "Bugen, Editing Flow.tsx".

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

name: PersonListItemName
description: The person's name. It truncates first, so the status stays whole.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

name: PersonListItemStatus
description: What the person is doing or has done ("viewing", "read this version", a time), in `text-footnote` and `foreground-muted`. The last status in a row ends the row; one before it stays beside the name. The name and a status followed by a status end with a comma only a screen reader hears, so the row is announced "Martin, viewing".

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.
